description: Under the Approvals page's title. "Socio" is a product noun: an AI agent. Auto review is a model that decides routine requests for you.
deleted-socio: In place of a socio's name once it was deleted.
toasts.undone: Toast after reversing an automatic approval.
waiting.count: How many requests wait for the person's decision.
policies.description: Manual, Auto and Bypass are the three policies (policies.policy.*): use the same words.
policies.socio: Label of the menu that picks the socio whose policies show.
policies.auto-on: Banner: {{socio}} is a socio's name, {{capabilities}} the actions it may do with auto approval.
policies.turn-off: Button that sets every auto policy of this socio back to manual.
policies.policy.manual: Each policies.policy.* key: an approval policy. Manual: you decide every time; Auto: a model decides for you; Bypass: the socio goes ahead without asking.
policies.auto-unavailable: The Auto choice when this capability can't use it.
policies.risk.low: Each policies.risk.* key: a risk level, inside policies.limits.
policies.always: {{rules}} are rules, in English from the server, for what always comes to the person.
policies.select: Accessible name of a capability's policy menu; {{capability}} is its name.
guidance.description: Keep the quoted example as an example of what a person might write, in your language.
guidance.length: How many characters the guidance has, of the most it may have.
recent.filter: Accessible name of the menu that filters the recent decisions.
recent.filters.bypass: Decisions made by the Bypass policy (policies.policy.bypass).
audit.events.requested: Each audit.events.* key: one kind of entry in the audit log of requests, decisions and policy changes. A socio asked for approval.
